851-1283-1651-4365-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Adrix and Nev and Mondrak.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
851-1283-1651-4365-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

339-677-4359-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5231-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5231-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

3177-4270-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
3177-4270-7857.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-7267.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Michelangelo
Repeat.

876-1129-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
876-1129-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Harabaz Druid.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Harabaz Druid.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Harabaz Druid.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Harabaz Druid.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Harabaz Druid.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Harabaz Druid from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1368-3480-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3480-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

184-4682-5921.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents which are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
184-4682-5921.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice for each opponent you have, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

972-2792-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2792-7487.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Zealous Lorecaster by paying its mana cost.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster and the Great Whale token.
When the Zealous Lorecaster and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2792-7487.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Zealous Lorecaster instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-6596-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Hermes
1618-2440-6596-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Hermes triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-6596-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Hermes. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1558-1671-2638-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-2638-4231-6753.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-7297.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

628-5315-7219.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability
Repeat.

147-802-7089.easyPrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
147-802-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting any creature.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Snap.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Dualcaster Mage. When it enters, it triggers, copying Snap, targeting any other creature.
Resolve Snap, returning the targeted creature from the battlefield to its owner's hand and untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Resolve the original Dualcaster Mage spell. When it enters, it triggers, copying Snap, with Snap targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to its owner's hand and untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 5.

1796-2191-7070.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-5768-6965.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5768-6965.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

624-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. When it enters, it triggers, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phantasmal Image's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-2741-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2741-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-3641-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-3641-4050-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Distinguished Conjurer indestructible.
3490-3641-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

4125-4872-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
4125-4872-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}.
4125-4872-5626.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1445-4068-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
You control at least one Mountain.
1445-4068-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1601-1978-5003.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value seven or greater.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-1978-5003.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing another creature with mana value seven or greater, adding at least seven {B}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Repeat.

1379-1530-2496-3658.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least 4 life.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Anrakyr the Traveller.
Anrakyr the Traveller does not have summoning sickness.
1379-1530-2496-3658.description:
Delare Anrakyr the Traveller as an attacker.
Anrakyr the Traveller triggers, allowing you to cast Second Chance by paying 3 life.
At the end of your turn, your life total becomes 5.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-1738-4961.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
314-1738-4961.description:
Cast Inscription of Abundance by paying {1}{G}, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's power.
Vito triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1306-1778-2303-2538.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Mana Crypt, due to Words of Wind.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Memnite, due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

287-1560-2290-2510.notablePrerequisites:
An enchantment exiled by Semblance Anvil.
You have at least 3 life.
287-1560-2290-2510.description:
Pay 2 life to cast Molting Skin.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder to activate it, gaining 2 life.
Resolve Molting Skin.
Return Molting Skin to your hand to activate it, regenerating any target creature.
Repeat.

1687-2557-3389-4050.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, attaching it to Siona.
Siona triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Human Soldier tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
